features.label: Strap length extension
features.text: Increases the circumference of existing Rebound Air Walker closure straps to accommodate larger legs.

features.label: Versatile accommodation
features.text: Ideal for patients with large calves, thick bandages, or those wearing the walker over a cast.

features.label: Tool free installation
features.text: Simple hook and loop attachment connects directly to original straps for an instant adjustment.

features.label: Universal compatibility
features.text: One size design fits the full range of Rebound Air Walker sizes from Extra Small to Extra Large.

features.label: Cost effective accessory
features.text: Eliminates the need to purchase a larger sized walking boot when swelling or dressing thickness increases.

features.label: Durable secure fit
features.text: High quality materials ensure the extension stays in place during daily mobility and rehabilitation.

features.label: Perfect fit guarantee
features.text: Free virtual fitting and adjustment session with US-based brace specialists.

measurement: This is a universal accessory designed to fit all sizes of the Ossur Rebound Air Walker (XS through XL). No specific measurements are required as the extension adjusts to your current strap needs. For personalized sizing assistance, take advantage of our Perfect Fit Guarantee .
